_comment: Source of truth for the gallery and the downloads. One entry per design; the first theme is the default. Run python3 scripts/build.py after editing this file or any template.

templates.name: Aurora
templates.for: Technical program managers, producers, and product people
templates.description: Dark glass panels, a particle field, and an icon rail that expands on hover. Sections for experience, projects, a media showcase, and skill bars.
notes: The typed lines in the hero come from data-lines on the #typed element. Separate lines with a | character.
Each skill bar reads data-level (0 to 100) on its .skill element; the label and the bar width both come from that one number.
Showcase: replace a .poster card with an or a YouTube/Vimeo

templates.name: Editorial
templates.description: A paper-and-ink magazine page: masthead, a big serif headline, a work index, a pull quote, and an experience table.
notes: Each work item links to a note further down the page (href="#northwind" matches id="northwind"). Keep the pairs matched when you rename projects.

templates.name: Signal
templates.description: A stark engineer's index. Select a project and the note beside it updates. No cards, no gradients.
notes: Project text lives in data-title, data-year, data-stack, and data-copy on each .row button. The detail panel on the right is filled from those attributes, so edit the attributes rather than the panel.

templates.name: Atelier
templates.description: Oversized type on a ground that changes color as you move through the work. Three projects, a practice statement, and one very large email link.
notes: data-tone on each .case button sets the background the page turns when that project is hovered or focused. Tones are defined in the stylesheet: paper, ink, signal.

templates.name: Monograph
templates.for: Architects, researchers, and studios with a body of work
templates.description: A sticky monograph cover beside a long list of projects. For practices whose work is best read as a list.
notes: The big letter on the cover is data-field="initial". Change it to your own initial or delete the element.

templates.name: Bento
templates.description: A tile grid: name, about, what you are doing now, three projects, and a way to write to you.
notes: Every tile is a <section class="tile">. Add or remove tiles freely; the grid reflows.

templates.name: Vita
templates.description: A one-page résumé: summary, experience, education, and skills. Prints to a clean PDF with a button that hides itself on paper.
notes: Use the Print / Save as PDF button (or your browser's print command) to export a PDF. The button and any colored rules are hidden or simplified in print.

templates.name: Plate
templates.description: A photography contact sheet. Swap each colored frame for your own image; click a frame to open it large with its caption.
notes: Replace a frame's background with your own photo: style="background-image: url('photos/coast.jpg')" and put the file in a photos folder next to index.html.
The lightbox shows the same background image larger. For a different large version, add data-full="photos/coast-large.jpg" to the frame.

templates.name: Proof
templates.description: Case studies that lead with the outcome: a big metric on the cover, then the role and a short account.
notes: Each case has a cover color class (c1, c2, c3). Reuse them or add c4 in the stylesheet for more studies.

templates.name: Ledger
templates.description: Services with starting prices, a four-step process, three testimonials, and a booking call to action. Built to turn a visit into an email.
notes: Prices are plain text inside data-field="price". Replace with "On request" if you do not publish rates.
The booking button is a mailto link. Swap the href for a Calendly or Cal.com URL if you use one.

templates.name: Thesis
templates.description: Publications grouped by year with DOI and PDF links, teaching, talks, and a CV link. Reads like a well-kept department page.
notes: Publications are grouped under <h3 class="year"> headings. Each <li class="pub"> has a DOI link and a PDF link; delete either link if you do not have one.
The CV link in the header expects a cv.pdf next to index.html.

templates.name: Reel
templates.description: A full-width video hero, a selected work list with runtimes, a credits table, and a stills grid.
notes: The hero holds a placeholder. Replace the <div class="video-placeholder"> with a YouTube or Vimeo <iframe>; the exact embed code to paste is in a comment right above it.
Stills are colored frames. Replace each with an or a background-image, as in the Plate template.

templates.name: Marquee
templates.description: Listen links, an upcoming-dates table, a releases grid, and a press quote. Loud type, one accent color.
notes: Listen buttons link to Spotify, Apple Music, and Bandcamp. Delete the ones you do not use.
Each release is a colored square. Replace the square with an of the cover art.

templates.name: Folio
templates.description: A column grid of artwork with captions and a lightbox, plus a short commissions note. The art is the page.
notes: Each
Clicking a piece opens it in a lightbox with its caption. No library is involved; it is a native <dialog>.

templates.name: Dispatch
templates.description: Clippings with outlet, date, and link, grouped by beat, with a newsletter signup. Newsprint columns and a dateline.
notes: Each clipping is an <article class="clip"> with outlet, date, headline link, and a one-line description. Newest first is the convention.
The newsletter button links to a URL; point it at your Substack, Buttondown, or Ghost page.

templates.name: Cohort
templates.description: Offerings, upcoming workshops with dates, student quotes, and an FAQ that opens and closes. Warm and direct.
notes: The FAQ uses native <details> elements; copy one <details> block per question. No JavaScript needed.

templates.name: Primer
templates.description: A short hero, three projects told as what I did and what I learned, skills, and contact. The most heavily commented file in the set.
notes: Every block has a comment explaining what it is and whether to copy it. Start with the HOW TO EDIT comment at the top of the file.

templates.name: Collective
templates.description: Services, a row of client names, team cards, an approach section, and contact. One page that reads as a company, not a person.
notes:
Team members are
cards with a colored initial block. Replace the block with an for a photo.

templates.name: Pixel
templates.description: Project cards with platform and engine tags, itch.io and Steam links, a dev-log list, and screenshot frames that reveal on hover.
notes: Each project has a .shot frame. Replace its background with a screenshot: style="background-image: url('shots/game.png')".
Platform and engine tags are plain <li> items; add as many as you need.
